actual: After a real 15-day dual-Program batch completed 30/30 days, POST refresh-outcomes created parent operation ahrop_6fb7a472a4c94d9be366c5673aaac2fe. The background command claims that parent as RUNNING, then each per-run OutcomeService sub-operation tries to transition another REFRESH_OUTCOMES row for the same batch to RUNNING and violates uq_advisory_historical_range_operation_running_type. Operation fails at OUTCOME_SUB_OPERATIONS with UniqueViolation and writes zero outcomes. Repair must preserve one active-operation invariant, durable parent visibility, per-run idempotency/CAS, error visibility, and independent single/native-multi outcome processing without direct SQL or status rewriting.
